# Sources

Every data source used by the Lunar Landing Site Navigator, its link, and what it is used for.
**Generated, do not edit by hand:** run `npm run sources:doc` after adding or removing a source
(the test suite fails if this file is out of date). In the app, the same information appears in every
tooltip and on the Data & methods page.

## 1. Data sources

| Source | Provider | Link | Used for | Used in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| JPL Horizons System (API), DE441 ephemeris | NASA JPL | https://ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/doc/horizons.html | Hourly sub-solar point, sub-Earth point (libration) and distances for the whole Moon, 2024–2032; Moon elevation at DSN complexes. All Sun/Earth angles at every site come from these tables. | 94 metrics |
| Moon Trek map tiles (LRO LOLA / LROC WAC) | NASA JPL / Solar System Treks | https://trek.nasa.gov/moon/ | South-pole and global basemap tiles. | panels / pages |
| LROC QuickMap | NASA LRO / Arizona State University | https://quickmap.lroc.asu.edu/ | Cross-checking landing-site positions, terrain and imagery; link-outs from every site. | panels / pages |
| LRO LOLA gridded elevation (PDS Geosciences Node) | NASA LRO / PDS | https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/missions/lro/lola.htm | Terrain heights for horizon masks, slopes, relief and site elevation. | 88 metrics |
| NASA GSFC Planetary Geodesy Data Archive | NASA GSFC | https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/ | High-resolution LOLA polar products and illumination references for validation. | 1 metric |
| NSSDCA Moon Fact Sheet | NASA GSFC | https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/moonfact.html | Physical constants: gravity, albedo, solar irradiance. | 7 metrics |
| NSSDCA Sun Fact Sheet | NASA GSFC | https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/sunfact.html | Solar radius (apparent size of the Sun's disk). | panels / pages |
| NSSDCA Earth Fact Sheet | NASA GSFC | https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/earthfact.html | Earth radius (apparent size of Earth's disk seen from the Moon). | 1 metric |
| DSN Telecommunications Link Design Handbook (810-005) | NASA JPL DSN | https://deepspace.jpl.nasa.gov/dsndocs/810-005/ | DSN complex locations and antenna performance for ground-station visibility and link estimates. | 5 metrics |
| Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature | IAU / USGS (NASA-funded) | https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/ | Named craters and mountains: search, landmark distances, reference pins. | 4 metrics |
| LRO Diviner Lunar Radiometer | NASA LRO / UCLA | https://www.diviner.ucla.edu/ | Measured surface temperatures and thermal properties. | 4 metrics |
| Permanently shadowed regions (LOLA/LROC) | NASA LRO | https://www.lroc.asu.edu/atlases/psr | Location of permanently shadowed regions (cold traps) near each site. | 7 metrics |
| NASA SVS: Moon Phase and Libration | NASA GSFC Scientific Visualization Studio | https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/gallery/moonphase/ | Educator explainer for libration (our libration numbers come from Horizons). | 1 metric |
| NAIF SPICE toolkit and kernels | NASA JPL NAIF | https://naif.jpl.nasa.gov/ | Reference for frames and ephemerides; Horizons serves the same DE441 data, so SPICE is the documented fallback. | 1 metric |
| NASA Commercial Lunar Payload Services | NASA | https://www.nasa.gov/commercial-lunar-payload-services/ | CLPS mission list, targets and dates. | 7 metrics |
| NASA Artemis candidate landing regions | NASA | https://www.nasa.gov/artemis/ | The nine south-pole candidate landing regions NASA announced in Oct 2024 (then for Artemis III; the first crewed landing is now planned as Artemis IV). | 2 metrics |
| LROC landing-site imaging | NASA LRO / ASU | https://www.lroc.asu.edu/ | Measured positions of landers seen in LRO images. | 13 metrics |
| CSA Moon exploration | Canadian Space Agency | https://www.asc-csa.gc.ca/eng/astronomy/moon-exploration/ | Partner-agency context for educators and the public. | panels / pages |
| Project metrics catalog (Draft 3) | This project | https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/151XYyyy9HRlFYEFu9zvzud_sK3iOMXjHK_wNixa7Cr8/edit?gid=380290889 | Definitions, units and persona wording for all 196 metrics. | panels / pages |
| Bryant (2009), IPN Progress Report 42-176 | NASA JPL | https://ipnpr.jpl.nasa.gov/progress_report/42-176/176C.pdf | Method: Sun/Earth visibility at the lunar poles, disk thresholds, tower-height effects. | 8 metrics |
| Liu et al. (2023), south-polar landing area selection | Journal of Deep Space Exploration | https://doi.org/10.15982/j.issn.2096-9287.2023.20220091 | Method: visible solar-disk coefficient f(t), illumination + slope qualifying areas. | 3 metrics |
| Cited lunar reference values | NASA / peer-reviewed | in-app /sources#reference-values | Global (not site-specific) reference values; each cites its own document. | 13 metrics |
| Mission assumptions (editable) | You | in-app /sources#assumptions | Vehicle and mission inputs (array size, battery, thresholds). Defaults are examples; change them in the planner panel. | 38 metrics |
